Plugin.Name: FRR (FRRouting)
Plugin.Overview: Optional FRRouting (FRR) for Unraid — fully automated (Nvidia Driver style): downloads and installs the matching package set for your Unraid version, enables zebra/fabricd (and optional OSPF/BGP/…), Settings UI. Standalone — Thunderbolt Net not required. Does not edit eth0/br0 by default. Pair with Thunderbolt Net for TB multi-host OpenFabric.
